title: Album release: Give More Love by Ringo Starr | 2017
content:
Give More Love, Ringo Starr’s 19th studio album, was released worldwide on 15 September 2017.

The album was announced on 7 July 2017, Starr’s 77th birthday. The title track was made available that day as a digital download and on streaming services.

A second single, ‘We’re On The Road Again’, was released on 18 July, followed by ‘So Wrong For So Long’ on 18 August. The final single, ‘Standing Still’, was issued on 8 September.

Give More Love was released on 15 September 2017. It was not a commercial success, although it reached number 18 in the Czech Republic. In the US it peaked at 128 on the Billboard 200.

Page last updated: 14 July 2022
